sections.title: Traits
lines:
Legendary Resistance (3/day). Trostani can turn a failed saving throw into a success.
Magic Resistance. Trostani has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Magic Weapons. Her weapon attacks are magical.
Speak with Beasts and Plants. She can communicate with beasts and plants as if they share a language.
Tree Stride. Once on her turn, spend 10 ft. of movement to magically enter a living tree within reach and emerge in an open space within 5 ft. of a second living tree. The trees must both be Large or larger and within 60 ft. of each other.

sections.title: Innate Spellcasting
lines:
Wisdom (spell save DC 24), with no material components.
At will. Dispel Magic, Druidcraft.
3/day each. Bless, Conjure Animals, Giant Insect, Moonbeam, Plant Growth, Spike Growth, Suggestion.
1/day each. Conjure Fey, Mass Cure Wounds.

sections.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Use Constrict, use Touch of Order, and cast one spell with a casting time of 1 action.
Constrict. Melee weapon attack, +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. A hit deals 15 (3d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage. The creature is grappled (escape DC 19) and restrained until that grapple ends. Trostani can hold up to three targets at once.
Touch of Order. Melee spell attack, +16 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. A hit deals 23 (3d8 + 10) radiant damage. Trostani can suppress the magic of one visible magic item in the target’s possession until her next turn starts. Artifacts are exempt.
Wrath of Mat’Selesnya (Recharge 5–6). Choose a visible point within 60 ft. Each creature in the 30-ft. cube there makes a DC 24 Dexterity save. Failure deals 21 (6d6) bludgeoning plus 21 (6d6) slashing damage. Success halves both.

sections.title: Legendary actions
lines:
The creature can spend up to three legendary actions, choosing one option at a time at the end of another creature’s turn. It regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.
Voice of Harmony (1 action). Make one melee attack with advantage.
Voice of Life (1 action). Grant 20 temporary HP to another visible creature within 120 ft.
Voice of Order (1 action). Cast Dispel Magic.
Chorus of the Conclave (2 actions). Cast Suggestion, spending a daily use.
Awaken Grove Guardians (3 actions). One or two visible trees within 120 ft. uproot and become Awakened Trees for 1 minute or until Trostani ends the effect as a bonus action. They understand Druidic and follow her spoken orders. They cannot speak. In the absence of orders they follow her and Dodge.

sections.title: Source notes
lines: The print pairs Strength 19 with a +5 modifier. This profile keeps the printed score and Constrict numbers. The usual modifier for Strength 19 is +4.

sections.title: Roleplaying
lines: Trostani wants every community to join the Conclave. She takes a member’s departure as a betrayal. Her three personalities disagree over how to meet Ravnica’s rising tensions. See p. 251.

sections.title: Traits
lines:
Amphibious. Zegana breathes air and water.
Legendary Resistance (3/day). She can turn a failed saving throw into a success.
Magic Resistance. She has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.

sections.title: Spellcasting
lines:
Zegana is a 15th-level Simic spellcaster with prepared wizard spells. Intelligence sets spell save DC 18 and +10 to hit with spell attacks.
Cantrips (at will). Acid Splash, Druidcraft, Ray of Frost, Shape Water.
1st level (4 slots). Color Spray, Expeditious Retreat, Fog Cloud, Shield.
2nd level (3 slots). Enlarge/Reduce, Gust of Wind.
3rd level (3 slots). Counterspell, Fly, Slow.
4th level (3 slots). Control Water, Ice Storm, Polymorph.
5th level (2 slots). Conjure Elemental, Creation.
6th level (1 slot). Move Earth, Wall of Ice.
7th level (1 slot). Prismatic Spray, Teleport.
8th level (1 slot). Control Weather, Dominate Monster.

sections.title: Actions
lines:
Prime Speaker’s Trident. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 12 (2d6 + 5) piercing damage and the trident booms. Each creature in a 15-ft. cube from its prongs makes a DC 18 Constitution save. Failure deals 9 (2d8) thunder damage, or 13 (3d8) to a creature underwater, and pushes the creature 10 ft. away from Zegana. Success halves the thunder damage and prevents the push.
Deluge (Recharge 4–6). Send a wave to an area within 120 ft., up to 30 ft. long, 10 ft. wide, and 10 ft. high. Each creature there makes a DC 18 Dexterity save. Failure deals 18 (4d8) bludgeoning damage and knocks it prone. Success halves the damage and prevents the knockdown. The water puts out unprotected flames it touches before vanishing.

sections.title: Legendary actions
lines:
The creature can spend up to three legendary actions, choosing one option at a time at the end of another creature’s turn. It regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.
Adaptive Skin (1 action). Gain resistance to acid, fire, lightning, or thunder damage until her next turn starts.
Trident (1 action). Make one melee attack with the Prime Speaker’s Trident.
Enlarge (2 actions). Cast Enlarge/Reduce on herself using Enlarge without spending a spell slot.
Deluge (3 actions). Use Deluge if available.

sections.title: Roleplaying
lines: Zegana treats nature’s patterns as a guide for improving life. She commits her resources to Ravnica and struggles to understand anyone who rejects progress. See p. 254.

sections.title: Damage resistances
lines: Bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks.

sections.title: Traits
lines:
Armor of Spiders (Mythic Trait, recharges after a short or long rest). When Arasta drops to 0 HP, she stays conscious and alive. She regains 200 HP, and her spiders cover her body and grant 100 temporary HP. While she retains temporary HP from this trait, her mythic actions are available.
Legendary Resistance (3/day). Arasta can turn a failed saving throw into a success.
Magic Resistance. The creature has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
Spider Climb. Arasta can climb difficult surfaces and ceilings upside down without making an ability check.
Web Walker. Webbing does not hinder Arasta's movement.

sections.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and two Claws attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +14 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. A hit deals 20 (3d8 + 7) piercing damage. The target also makes a DC 21 Constitution save, taking 32 (5d12) poison damage on a failure or half on a success. If this damage reduces the creature to 0 HP, it stabilizes and is poisoned for 1 hour, even if it recovers HP. It is paralyzed while poisoned this way.
Claws. Melee weapon attack, +14 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 17 (3d6 + 7) slashing damage.
Web of Hair (Recharge 4–6). Fill a 30-ft. cube adjacent to Arasta with webbing for 1 minute. The cube is lightly obscured and difficult terrain. A creature that moves into the web or starts its turn there makes a DC 21 Dexterity save. On a failure, it is restrained while in the web. A creature can use its action to attempt a DC 21 Strength check to free itself or a creature within 5 ft. restrained by this web. Only magical fire can damage the web. A 5-ft. cube burns away if it takes at least 20 magical fire damage on one turn.

sections.title: Legendary actions
lines:
Arasta has 3 legendary actions. Use one option at the end of another creature's turn. She recovers spent actions at the start of her turn.
Claws (1 action). Make one Claws attack.
Swarm (2 actions). Summon two swarms of spiders in unoccupied spaces within 5 ft. of Arasta.
Toxic Web (3 actions). Each creature restrained by her Web of Hair takes 18 (4d8) poison damage.

sections.title: Mythic actions
lines:
These options spend legendary actions and are available only while Arasta retains temporary HP from Armor of Spiders.
Swipe (1 action). Make two Claws attacks.
Web of Hair (2 actions). Recharge and use Web of Hair.
Nyx Weave (2 actions). Each creature restrained by Web of Hair must pass a DC 21 Constitution save. On a failure, it takes 26 (4d12) force damage and any spells of 6th level or lower affecting it end.

sections.title: Mythic encounter
lines: If Arasta uses Armor of Spiders, award 66,000 XP total for defeating her. This is equivalent to defeating two CR 21 creatures.

sections.title: Lair actions
lines:
At initiative count 20, losing ties, choose one of the following options. The same option cannot be used in successive rounds.
Read the Web. Each creature restrained by a web or by Web of Hair makes a DC 21 Intelligence save. For each failure, Arasta learns the creature's name, race, what it considers home, and why it came to her web.
Giant Insect. Arasta casts Giant Insect on spiders only. It lasts until she uses this lair option again or dies.

sections.title: Regional effects
lines:
One or both of these effects can shape the area within 1 mile of Arasta's lair.
Spiders and insects spy for Arasta. Birds and other flying creatures vanish from the skies, although some turn up trapped in webs.
Webs fill 10-ft. cubes of open space wherever two solid surfaces can anchor them. They burn away in 1 round when exposed to fire. Destroyed webs magically repair themselves at the next dawn.
On Arasta's death, the spiders and insects lose their link to her. The webs dissolve within 1d10 days.

versions.description: A decrepit minotaur with a dented crown and a clay amphora wanders the Katachthon foothills. He claims Mogis cursed him after he chose his child as his heir, and now tests strangers for the right to succeed him.

images.credit: Mythic Odysseys of Theros

sections.title: Starting hit points
lines: Antigonos uses the 2014 Minotaur and begins the encounter with 38 of its usual 76 HP. The listed Hit Dice and most other statistics come from the base creature.

sections.title: Traits
lines:
Charge. After moving at least 10 ft. straight toward a target, hitting it with Gore on the same turn deals an extra 9 (2d8) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 14 Strength save or be pushed up to 10 ft. away and knocked prone.
Labyrinthine Recall. Antigonos remembers every route he has traveled.
Reckless. At the start of his turn he can choose to gain advantage on melee weapon attack rolls that turn. If he does, attacks against him have advantage until the start of his next turn.
Decrepit State. Antigonos has disadvantage on his attack rolls.

sections.title: Actions
lines:
Greataxe. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 17 (2d12 + 4) slashing damage.
Gore. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage.
Amphora. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one Medium or smaller creature. A hit deals 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage. If the amphora is empty, the target is restrained inside. A restrained creature can use an action to make a DC 14 Dexterity (Acrobatics) check, escaping on a success. Destroying the amphora also ends the restraint. The amphora has AC 8, 20 HP, and immunity to poison and psychic damage.

sections.title: Test of the Amphora
lines:
Antigonos invites a Medium creature to climb into the amphora while he steadies it. After the creature enters, roll a d20.
1–9. He judges the creature too small and pours dirt into the amphora. The creature makes a DC 15 Constitution save. On a failure, it is blinded and restrained and begins suffocating. On a success, apply the effects of a hit from his Amphora attack.
10–19. He judges the creature too large and attacks it with his greataxe.
20. He declares the creature his heir, gives it his crown, robes, and belt pouch, and leaves.

sections.title: Contending with Antigonos
lines: He leaves if no one agrees to his test. Insults and theft can provoke him, and in a fight he may switch to random targets with his greataxe or empty amphora. If the party refrains from attacking him, he calms after a few rounds. A character who urges him to turn away from Mogis can make a DC 14 Charisma (Persuasion) check. On a success, he abandons the amphora and leaves to learn about a new deity. On a failure, he still departs in thought. Award experience for overcoming him whether or not the party fights.

sections.title: Printed source
lines: Mythic Odysseys of Theros, pp. 188–189, Broken King Antigonos encounter. Uses the 2014 Monster Manual Minotaur (p. 223) with the printed encounter changes.

sections.title: Traits

Success ends the effect and failure petrifies it. Greater Restoration or other magic can end the petrification. sections.title: Mythic actions
lines:

sections.title: Customizing a chimera
lines: Use the base configuration or roll one d4 on each customization table you want to use. Apply the chosen body adjustments and replace the corresponding breath, head, or tail option. Claws remain available in every configuration. Choose which result to keep if two conflict.

sections.title: Body Composition (d4)
lines:
1. Plains Creature. Give it a large lowland body such as a bear or bull. Remove its wings and fly speed. It gains resistance to cold and fire damage.
2. Coast Creature. Give it a coastal or aquatic body such as a heron or shark. It gains a swim speed equal to its walking speed and can breathe air and water.
3. Mountain Creature. Give it a mountain creature’s body such as a ram or dragon. It can fly out of an enemy’s reach without provoking an opportunity attack.
4. Swamp Creature. Give it a swamp or cave creature’s body such as a giant lizard or spider. It gains a climb speed equal to its walking speed and can climb hard surfaces and ceilings without an ability check.

sections.title: Head Attacks (d4)
lines:
1. Bull Horns. If it moves at least 20 ft. straight toward a target and hits with Head on that turn, deal an extra 7 (2d6) piercing damage. A creature hit must also pass a DC 15 Strength save or fall prone.
2. Shark Bite. Make Head attacks with advantage against creatures below their maximum hit points.
3. Unicorn Horn. Head is magical and deals an extra 4 (1d8) radiant damage.
4. Cockatrice Beak. A creature hit with Head must pass a DC 15 Constitution save or become restrained. It repeats the save at the end of its next turn. A success ends the restraint. A failure petrifies it for 24 hours.

sections.title: Breath Weapons (d4)
lines:
All four alternatives recharge on 5–6.
1. Lightning Breath. Each creature in a line 60 ft. long and 5 ft. wide makes a DC 15 Dexterity save. Deal 36 (8d8) lightning damage on a failure or half on a success.
2. Tidal Wave Breath. Each creature in a line 60 ft. long and 5 ft. wide makes a DC 15 Dexterity save. A failure deals 27 (5d10) acid damage and knocks the creature prone. A success halves the damage and leaves it standing.
3. Venom Spray. Each creature in a 15-ft. cone must pass a DC 15 Constitution save or become poisoned for 1 minute. While poisoned this way, it takes 35 (10d6) poison damage at the start of each of its turns. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns to end the effect.
4. Necrotic Breath. Each creature in a 15-ft. cone must pass a DC 15 Constitution save or take 31 (7d8) necrotic damage and lose the ability to regain hit points through the end of its next turn.

sections.title: Tail Attacks (d4)
lines:
1. Venomous Tail. The tail deals piercing damage. A creature hit by Tail must pass a DC 15 Constitution save or become poisoned for 1 minute. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns to end the effect.
2. Perplexing Tail. Replace the tail with a second head. Multiattack uses Claws and two Head attacks. Use the Head Attacks table to determine the added head. The breath substitution remains available.
3. Shark Tail. When Tail hits a creature, the fin also pushes it up to 10 ft. away.
4. Constricting Tail. Tail also grapples a Large or smaller creature it hits (escape DC 15). That creature is restrained while grappled and the tail stays occupied until it escapes or is released.

versions.description: A wandering kraken that wrecks fleets and coastal settlements. After Tromokratis toppled the Pyrgnos, Meletis began watching the sea for its return.

images.credit: Matt Stewart · Mythic Odysseys of Theros

sections.title: Damage immunities
lines: Fire. Also bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks.

sections.title: Traits
lines:
Amphibious. Tromokratis breathes air and water.
Hearts of the Kraken (mythic trait, recharges after a short or long rest). Upon dropping to 0 hit points, Tromokratis stays alive and conscious as its carapace cracks open. Track four hearts separately, two on the chest, one on the back, and one at the base of the tail. Each heart has AC 22 and 100 hit points. Each is immune to all conditions and to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks. Use ability scores of 10 (+0) for any saving throw a heart must make. After Tromokratis finishes a short or long rest, the carapace seals over its hearts and any destroyed hearts regenerate. Destroy all four hearts to kill it.
Legendary Resistance (3/day). Tromokratis can turn a failed save into a success.
Magic Weapons. Its weapon attacks are magical.
Siege Monster. It deals double damage to objects and structures.
Spell-Resistant Carapace. It has advantage on saves against spells. Spell attack rolls against it have disadvantage.

sections.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make one Pincer, one Tail, and one Tentacle Grasp attack.
Pincer. Melee weapon attack, +18 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Deal 20 (3d6 + 10) bludgeoning damage on a hit. A creature hit is grappled (escape DC 26) and restrained. Tromokratis can target only that creature with Pincer until the grapple ends.
Tail. Melee weapon attack, +18 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Deal 23 (3d8 + 10) bludgeoning damage on a hit. A creature hit falls prone.
Tentacle Grasp. Melee weapon attack, +18 to hit, reach 20 ft., one creature. Deal 20 (3d6 + 10) bludgeoning damage on a hit and grapple it (escape DC 26). If the creature is still grappled at the end of its next turn, Tromokratis throws it up to 60 ft. in a straight line. The creature lands prone and takes 21 (6d6) bludgeoning damage.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +18 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Deal 29 (3d12 + 10) piercing damage on a hit. If the target is a Large or smaller creature that Tromokratis has grappled, the Bite also swallows it and ends the grapple. A swallowed creature is blinded and restrained, has total cover from attacks and effects outside the kraken, and takes 42 (12d6) acid damage at the start of each of Tromokratis’s turns. If any single swallowed creature deals at least 50 damage to Tromokratis on one turn, the kraken makes a DC 20 Constitution save at that turn’s end. On a failure it regurgitates all swallowed creatures, which fall prone in spaces within 10 ft. If Tromokratis dies, its restraint ends. A swallowed creature can then spend 15 ft. of movement to leave the corpse, emerging prone.

sections.title: Legendary actions
lines:
Tromokratis has 3 legendary actions and regains spent actions at the start of its turn. Use one option at the end of another creature’s turn.
Move (1 action). Move up to half its speed.
Tail (1 action). Make one Tail attack.
Bite (3 actions). Make one Bite attack.

sections.title: Mythic actions
lines:
For 1 hour after Hearts of the Kraken activates, Tromokratis can spend legendary actions on these options while its mythic trait is active.
Rampage (1 action). Make one Tail attack and one Tentacle Grasp attack.
Coral Growth (2 actions). Each creature within 10 ft. makes a DC 25 Dexterity save. Deal 13 (3d8) slashing damage on a failure or half on a success. Tromokratis and each of its hearts gain +2 AC until the start of its next turn.

sections.title: Mythic encounter
lines: For the optional second phase, use Hearts of the Kraken when the kraken drops to 0 HP. Treat the full encounter as two CR 26 creatures and award 180,000 XP if the party defeats Tromokratis after the hearts were exposed.
